svg.title: Isochrones by mode from Helsinki Central Station
svg.desc: Four maps of the Helsinki capital region, one per mode, each shading the areas reached from Helsinki Central Station within 15, 30 and 45 minutes. Walking reaches the peninsula of the centre; cycling most of Helsinki; driving, with free-flowing traffic, most of the region; public transport reaches long arms along the metro to the east and the west and along the railway lines to the north.
